◉ **Sprint: sprint-185**
   Title: Sprint 185 — Component Breadth Wave 1: five components into the nucleus, six saved schemas made real
   Focus: Component breadth is the binding constraint (decision #1723) and the s182 promotion freeze is void (decision #1722). Add DetailHeader, CardHeader, ColorSwatch, ColorizedBadge and VizAreaPreview to NUCLEUS_COMPONENT_IDS as real, versioned, installable React and Vue components with token-driven styles across the six brand/theme cells, and prove them by taking the six pre-existing saved schemas they block (cmos-messages-redesign, plan-form-dark, pt-shop-parts-entry-router-v1, user-card-showcase, cmos-dashboard-redesign, the-academy-landing-v1) through LIVE code.generate and the eight packed-consumer gates in both frameworks — reachable saved schemas move from 5/16 to 11/16. Measured at base 1118f436 by executing the real emitter: every one of the 12 target cells fails today with only OODS-N015 on exactly these five ids, and with those nodes pruned all 12 cells generate green — planning inferred a pure port, but build execution disproved that inference: readiness had hidden a read-only header binding and old-input B2 remeasurement exposed a CardHeader recipe-directive regression, both now repaired (decisions #1734 and #1738). Mission zero retires the voided freeze from the live gates (three specs still run --check-promotion or pin the nucleus at 14/28) so the nucleus count becomes derived, never a literal. Closeout folds the s184 surface overlay into the capability baseline (surface cells are evidence, not denominator movement; 109 rows unchanged), computes ONE sprint-wide advertised-surface diff, sends the combined reconnect Sprint 184 owed and never sent, and discharges the s184 review carries. Exit gate: 6 schemas x 2 frameworks = 12 cells pass all applicable consumer gates from live generation, with per-component cross-framework mutation bites. missions.name: Capability-baseline surfaces and overlay fold, one sprint-wide advertised diff, combined reconnect, s184 review carries, closeout
missions.objective: Make the record truthful and the consumers informed, then stop without self-certifying. Decision #1726: surface cells are evidence, the s184 overlay folds into the baseline. Next-step #1363: one sprint-wide advertised-surface diff replaces per-mission scoped diffs — the s184 structure missed five consumer-relevant movers, including the nucleus Table change, and the consumers were never told. Next-step #1362: that reconnect is still owed and is sent here together with Sprint 185's own movers. The remaining Sprint 184 review carries (#1364, #1365, #1366, C1 residual, C5) are discharged or disclosed by name.

missions.name: Retire the voided freeze from the live gates; derive the nucleus count from NUCLEUS_COMPONENT_IDS
missions.objective: Before any component is added, make the live test and gate surface indifferent to nucleus SIZE while still discriminating nucleus TRUTH (decision #1725; the freeze itself is void per #1722). At base 1118f436 three specs still enforce the s182 promotion freeze — ported-freeze.s184.spec.ts asserts the nucleus is 14 and foundationV1Cells is 28, byte-pins 8 surfaces and 11 id-list files against m04 base 158a34bf, and RUNS generate-s182-m05-closeout.mjs --check-promotion; independent-review-approval.s183.spec.ts runs --write-promotion/--check-promotion against the live tree and asserts 28 cells; readiness-ref-enforcement.s184.spec.ts pins the frozen s182 consumer.mjs sha — and roughly twelve more test and script sites hardcode 14 or 28. Adding one id to the nucleus today goes red on literals. This mission measures that first, then fixes it, then proves the fix reds only for the right reasons.

missions.name: Contracts, shared scenarios, prop-value contracts and token-driven styles for the five; nucleus 14 to 19
missions.objective: Make DetailHeader, CardHeader, ColorSwatch, ColorizedBadge and VizAreaPreview real at the contract layer before any framework code exists: versioned contracts in the nucleus map, shared behavioral scenarios, PROP_VALUE_CONTRACTS entries, and token-driven CSS across the six declared brand/theme cells. NUCLEUS_COMPONENT_IDS goes from 14 to 19 here. Decisions #1727 (VizAreaPreview is a frame, not a chart) and #1728 (CardHeader introduced, Card note amended, props from measurement, version moves on shape not prose). Contract props are set from what the six schemas actually put on these nodes plus what the HTML renderers consume — not invented.

missions.name: React and Vue implementations as root exports, readiness rows with resolving evidence, packed proof, cross-framework bites
missions.objective: Implement the five in @oods/components-react and @oods/components-vue as ROOT exports of the nucleus — not a subpath — idiomatic per framework, with readiness rows whose six evidence classes all resolve, and prove them from clean packed consumers. No React or Vue implementation of any of the five exists at base; the HTML renderers are the semantic reference. Parity is a computed comparison, never two independent passes.

missions.name: Live exit gate: the six pre-existing schemas through live code.generate and the consumer gates in both frameworks
missions.objective: Prove from LIVE generation that each of the six pre-existing saved schemas — cmos-messages-redesign, plan-form-dark, pt-shop-parts-entry-router-v1, user-card-showcase, cmos-dashboard-redesign, the-academy-landing-v1 — installs, typechecks, builds, server-renders, mounts, hydrates, resolves shared CSS and, wherever the schema declares an interaction, passes it in clean isolated React and Vue consumers. Twelve cells. Decision #1730 governs the schemas without interactions. The planning probe is the red control: at 1118f436 all twelve cells fail with only OODS-N015 on the five ids. Forge's own detail template (the s183 B2 regression) is re-measured now that DetailHeader exists.
